device_entry.name: 泰克 TDS1012 数字存储示波器
tags: 瞬态信号采集与同步触发测量
device_entry.description: 一款 100 MHz、2 通道数字存储示波器，用于采集和观察电信号波形，并进行频率、均值、最小值、最大值等基础测量。该设备支持触发、自动设置、自动校准和波形数据读取，适合电子实验与信号调试。
device_entry.description_en: A 100 MHz, 2-channel digital storage oscilloscope used to capture and visualize electrical waveforms and perform basic measurements such as frequency, mean, minimum, and maximum. It supports triggering, autoset, autocalibration, and waveform data transfer for electronics experiments and signal debugging.
